scope: training coverage extension; same observed development and regression; no fresh validation
training: Reuse all compatible components and exact 12 frozen character-crossfit v4/source profiles; independently trial shared isotropic moves toward the public component layout on training-fold targets only
intervention: Trial moves may be proposed even inside the empirical layout band, only during crossfit training. Keep original D donor, no source compression, no per-stroke transform. Existing geometry invariants/crossing/arc gates apply. Score all generated trials after generation boundary
labels: Same geometry improvement, each stroke max increase<=0.005, character angle increase<=0.5deg; mean repeats within component; only actual changed, valid-reference trials labeled
grouping: Query character excluded before scaling; median features per author-character for IQR; nearest component/proposal in each author-character may vote once; minimum5, maximum8, distance<=2, scale floor0.1; same as previous grouped risk gate
inference: Gate the original frozen M_D_1.0 proposal only. No trial strengths or additional component combinations can be generated at inference. Original D/M and source donor fixed
control: All-component observational training examples (33) versus counterfactual training, both through same grouped learner; control at frozen scope/threshold in regression
selection: Select counterfactual arm on existing user001 development: strictly improve mean geometry vsD, angle<=D+0.5, each character<=1.05D, each stroke max increase<=0.005; same donors; tie author then higher threshold; otherwise D
limits: Trial labels are interventions, not natural independent writing variations; several moves/repeats/components of a character are dependent. Crossfit/full-train shift and manual evaluation limits remain. No naturalness probability claim
